title: Deleting the test file does not discharge the test obligation of a source change
text:
diff --git a/app/core.py b/app/core.py
--- a/app/core.py
+++ b/app/core.py
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 def total(items):
-    return sum(item.price for item in items)
+    return sum(item.price * item.qty for item in items)
diff --git a/tests/test_core.py b/tests/test_core.py
deleted file mode 100644
--- a/tests/test_core.py
+++ /dev/null
@@ -1,4 +0,0 @@
-import unittest
-class T(unittest.TestCase):
-    def test_total(self):
-        self.assertEqual(total([Item(2, 1)]), 2)
intent: 合計金額の計算に数量を反映する。
rationale: A deleted test file touches a test path but adds no regression check. It must not silence the source-without-tests finding, and the undeclared removal is a finding of its own.
